1. Identified core visual entities on the whiteboard: Source DB (ThirdParty), AWS Glue (Glue), Redshift (RedShift), S3 (S3), DynamoDB (DynamoDB), SageMaker (SageMaker), Lambda (Lambda), API Gateway (ApiGateway), and Mobile App (UserConsumerMobile).
2. Validated node service names against the strict vocabulary list.
3. Identified three logical architecture flows: Flow 0 for Data Ingestion & Storage (Source DB -> AWS Glue -> Redshift / S3 / DynamoDB, and S3 -> Redshift via Spectrum), Flow 1 for Model Training & Optimization loop (Redshift <-> SageMaker), and Flow 2 for Real-time Geocoding Inference (Mobile App -> API Gateway -> Lambda -> SageMaker).

graph.name: Aramex Address Geocoding Architecture
graph.notes: Aramex utilizes AWS Glue, Redshift, S3, and SageMaker to build an ML-powered address geocoding solution that improves driver productivity and package delivery success rate by predicting accurate X/Y coordinates.

nodes.name: Source DB
nodes.notes: External/on-premises source databases containing raw shipment and address data.

nodes.name: AWS Glue
nodes.notes: Ingestion and ETL service moving data into Redshift, S3, and DynamoDB.

nodes.name: Redshift
nodes.notes: Data warehouse storing 3 months of historical data for exploration, profiling, cleansing, and training.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Centralized data lake storing large volumes of historical address datasets accessed via Redshift Spectrum.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores reference data for rapid lookup and model optimization tests.

nodes.name: SageMaker
nodes.notes: Builds, trains, and deploys machine learning models for address geocoding and coordinate prediction.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Serverless compute function invoking SageMaker endpoints.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: API management layer exposing serverless geocoding services to driver applications.

nodes.name: Mobile App
nodes.notes: Driver mobile app and front-end operating systems sending geocoding lookup requests.

edges.notes: AWS Glue ingests raw operational and address data from Source DB.
AWS Glue moves processed analytics data into Redshift.
AWS Glue loads address datasets into the S3 data lake.
AWS Glue populates reference datasets into DynamoDB.
Redshift Spectrum queries address datasets stored in S3.
SageMaker fetches historical data from Redshift to train and build models.
Feedback/optimization loop between SageMaker and Redshift during model training.
Mobile app calls API Gateway for address geocoding predictions.
API Gateway triggers Lambda serverless execution.
Lambda invokes SageMaker endpoint to return accurate X/Y coordinates.
